# Oktomusic

> Oktomusic is an open-source, self-hosted, opinionated music streaming server for your personal music collection.

## Project

- [GitHub](https://github.com/oktomusic/oktomusic): Source code, issues, and releases.
- [Documentation](https://oktomusic.afcms.dev): Installation, configuration, and usage guides.
- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://oktomusic.afcms.dev/llms.txt): Links to documentation in Markdown.
- [Full documentation for LLMs](https://oktomusic.afcms.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete documentation in a single text file.
